note: Both sets capture the same core facts correctly: turbine configuration, the two control systems and their goals/operating ranges, the nonpower-production omission, and the filter type with its y/u variable definitions. Set A adds four claims that merely restate facts already present (the blade-pitch operational range under a different entity name, the two-control-systems fact under two attribute names, and the generator-torque range with and without a condition), creating duplicates without adding information. Set B contains the same correct content with no duplicates and no invented or misbound claims, so it is the cleaner and better set.
remarks: Both sets miss several facts on the page: that generator speed measurement is the sole feedback input for both controllers, that no nacelle-yaw control actions were developed (and why yaw is neglected), the filter equations (7-1) and (7-2) including alpha = e^(-2*pi*Ts*fc) and the definitions of alpha, n, Ts and fc, and the filter state definition x[n] = y[n-1]. The text layer garbles the equation layout (symbols separated from terms), but the page image renders the equations legibly.
